capabilities.note: `forge tree [--sprint <id>] [--json]` and `forge sprint inspect <id> [--json]` are additional local projections of this same query (ADR 0005) — not separate capabilities, and not covered by the automated CLI-surface parity check below. The Desktop dashboard's sprint tree and sprint detail views are their counterpart and render the same shared lines.

`forge sprint inspect` shares the `sprint` command group but belongs to project.snapshot (a query), not this mutation capability. `forge sprint rebase` is a separate capability (`sprint.rebase`) below, not one of this id's verbs.

Not implemented on either surface. `SprintGitIsolation.RebaseAttemptAsync` (the git-level primitive this would wrap) already exists but has no reachable trigger: it recovers from a concurrent-integration race that can only occur once a node executor drives attempts through `SprintGitIsolation.IntegrateAsync`, and no executor exists yet (ADR 0020, ADR 0027).

Confirms a `NodeRole.Confirmation` node's own attempt lifecycle (no executor exists for this role -- `ExecutionProfilePolicy.PhaseFor` returns null for it) rather than through a human gate. Desktop parity (ADR 0037) reuses `MainPageViewModel.ResolveGateAsync`'s blank-means-active-sprint/ambiguity resolution and mandatory-confirmation shape exactly.

Settles a `NodeRole.TestWork` node's own attempt lifecycle (no executor exists for this role either -- `ExecutionProfilePolicy.PhaseFor` returns null for it too) rather than through a human gate. Unlike `workflow.confirm`, no downstream eligibility gate reads the recorded artifact's content -- `review`'s own graph dependency on this node is satisfied by the node reaching `succeeded` alone. Desktop parity landed alongside `workflow.confirm`/`workflow.finalize` (ADR 0037).

Merges the sprint's isolated integration branch into the project's own default branch (frozen as `SprintDefinition.DefaultBranch` at sprint creation) and completes the sprint -- fast-forward-only, refusing on a dirty or wrong-branch working directory, never running `git checkout` itself (ADR 0036). This is the first Forge operation of any kind that mutates the project's own working directory rather than an isolated worktree, so it stays human-only with no config-driven confirmation bypass, matching `workflow.review`/`attempt.supersede`/`workflow.confirm`/`workflow.test_work`. Desktop parity landed in ADR 0037.

Reserved, not implemented on either surface (desktop workspace redesign plan section 6.2, Slice 4). Deliberately absent from `CapabilityIds.Implemented` so a Host's handshake never advertises it before a real implementation lands -- the same reservation shape `quality.evaluate` used across its own CLI-only slice (ADR 0042).
Reserved, not implemented on either surface (plan section 6.3, Slice 4). Not yet in `CapabilityIds.Implemented`.
Reserved, not implemented on either surface (plan section 6.4, Slice 4). Not yet in `CapabilityIds.Implemented`.

Implemented on Host and CLI (plan section 7, Slice 2); Desktop parity is deferred to Slice 6, matching ADR 0037's CLI-first precedent for workflow.confirm/workflow.test_work/workflow.finalize. Not yet in `CapabilityIds.Implemented` -- that list requires both surfaces (capabilities.json's own `public_requires_both_surfaces` rule), so an older Desktop is never silently invited into a control it has no UI for.
